    Welcome to Elyqreth

    City Hall plans the mission. Your residents do the work.

    • Start a task to watch research, design, development, and testing.
    • Click a glowing agent or workplace to inspect it.
    • Drag the town or use arrow keys to pan. Scroll, pinch, or use + / − to zoom.
    • Residents take coffee breaks, read at Circuit Park, shop at Maker Market and return to shared apartments at night. Use the coffee and P buttons to visit the café and park. Work always takes priority.
    • Pause the whole town, change speed, or reset the mission at any time.
    • Missing a role? Add an agent and the mission resumes.

    A playful simulation. No real AI calls. Agents and missions reset when you reload.
